true_hope.title: True Hope
true_hope.text: The Hollow is healed. Every forgotten thing is remembered by someone.
true_hope.chapter_text: You hurt no one. You kept your promises. The forest is a little brighter where you walked, {player}, and the Archivist has started a new book — one where nothing gets erased.

balance.title: Balance
balance.text: The Hollow survives, but it is changed — and so are you.
balance.chapter_text: You did some good and some harm, like most people who are trying. The forest will remember both. The road to the Silent City is open.

isolation.title: Isolation
isolation.text: You leave everyone behind, and the Hollow forgets you in return.
isolation.chapter_text: You walked through the forest alone and helped no one find their way. It was efficient. It was very, very quiet.

corruption.title: Corruption
corruption.text: Power fills the space where your memories were.
corruption.chapter_text: The Lostlings hide when you pass. The pages you carry are heavy with names you erased. You are getting stronger, {player}. You are getting harder to remember as you were.

secret.title: The Hidden Truth
secret.text: You learn who erased you, and why.
secret.chapter_text: You found the place between the between and spoke to what wasn't finished. The Archivist's blank page fills itself with one line: "Filed by request of {player}." You erased yourself. Why?

developer.text: The one who made the Hollow is still here.
developer.chapter_text: "Warden. I gave you that name before I gave you anything else. You came back. Most don't." The Unfinished smiles, half-drawn. "Chapter Two isn't written yet. Want to help?"
